tweets.text: "America is coming back – bigger and better and stronger than ever before."
tweets.text_resolved: "America is coming back – bigger and better and stronger than ever before."

tweets.text: "Our tax cuts will breathe new life into the American economy... They will restore the hopes and dreams of the American family."
tweets.text_resolved: "Our tax cuts will breathe new life into the American economy... They will restore the hopes and dreams of the American family."

tweets.text: "If Congress sends me a bill before Christmas, the IRS has confirmed that Americans will see lower taxes and bigger paychecks beginning in February – just two short months from now."
tweets.text_resolved: "If Congress sends me a bill before Christmas, the IRS has confirmed that Americans will see lower taxes and bigger paychecks beginning in February – just two short months from now."

tweets.text: "The goal of my Administration is for every American to know the dignity of work, the pride of a paycheck, and the satisfaction of a job well done."
tweets.text_resolved: "The goal of my Administration is for every American to know the dignity of work, the pride of a paycheck, and the satisfaction of a job well done."

tweets.text: "We are going to make our tax system work for you again. We are going to make our economy work for you again. And we are going to make the American Dream real for you, and your children, and your grandchildren, once again."
